description: Sign this machine in to ClassCAD (a free classcad.ch account; Google, GitHub or email). Call it RIGHT AFTER installing the MCP. Not signed in: the first call opens the sign-in page in the user's browser and returns its link — show it to the user as a clickable link too — and the next call WAITS (up to ~50 s per call) until they have signed in in the browser, then returns their account. Call again while it reports "still waiting". Already signed in: returns the account at once. logout: true signs the machine out.
name: login
title: Sign in to ClassCAD
